free_tier.stated: Quoted: 'Open prize pool $2,140,000'. Grand prize, quoted: '$800,000 to the first team or individual to fully unroll and make readable a scroll from the set below. We also have prizes for second place ($100,000), third place ($50,000), and fourth place ($50,000) - $1,000,000 in total.' The door, quoted: 'Prizes will be awarded to any team or individual that fully digitally unrolls and makes readable ... one of the eligible CT scans', 'Anyone can help', and the only registration term: 'To qualify, you must have registered on the Vesuvius Challenge Discord at the time of the submission.' Computing is the entrant's, quoted: 'Unlimited time, compute, and manual effort may be spent creating generic ML datasets to train ML models.' Deadline, quoted: 'June 25th, 2027 (11:59pm Pacific)'.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Cash with no spending restriction, so it buys compute at any rate: USD 100,000 at Lambda's documented on-demand rate of USD 3.99 per H100 GPU-hour (compute/lambda) is about 25,000 H100-hours. The monthly progress prizes are the part that composes with a zero budget, because they pay before the grand prize is won and are sized for a weekend of work.

limits.value: the constraint is the science: the prize needs a fully automated unrolling pipeline judged reproducible by a technical team and legible by papyrologists, and the rules permit unlimited compute, which means the entrant funds the GPU time.
